purpose: Preserve quantitative values that can be recovered directly from Liu et al. (2019) and distinguish exact source records from useful but non-formal derivations. This record does not resolve the Jin/Liu condition-identity conflict and does not authorize a formal Fig. 14 reproduction.

primary_source.citation: Qili Liu, Damiano Baccarella, Brendan McGann, Tonghun Lee, Dual-Mode Operation and Transition in Axisymmetric Scramjets, AIAA Journal 57(11) (2019) 4764-4777.
locators: Fig. 2 and geometry text: circular inlet area contraction ratio 1.9 and 35 mm isolator diameter
Eq. (3) discussion: quasi-one-dimensional pressure relation explicitly neglecting wall friction
Eq. (5) discussion: quasi-one-dimensional Mach relation with negligible wall friction
Table 2: model B, C2H4, phi=1.03 row

nominal_freestream.static_pressure_unit_policy: not used here because the source table text/header rendering has been inconsistent across recoveries

reacting_property_model.classification: source-reported average properties used by Liu for reacting-flow analysis

table_2_model_B_C2H4_phi_1_03.locator: Table 2, model B, C2H4 row at phi=1.03

liu_quasi_1d_friction_statement.source_statement_semantics: Liu's own quasi-one-dimensional pressure/Mach analysis neglects or treats wall friction as negligible.
liu_quasi_1d_friction_statement.not_authorized_scope: This does not prove that Jin et al. used Cf=0 in the separate Fig. 14 reconstruction.

station3_total_pressure_from_table2.formal_use_policy: May be retained as a same-condition algebraic constraint for Liu model B phi=1.03, but does not resolve the Jin phi=1.04 identity conflict.

adiabatic_station3_total_temperature_bri.assumption: adiabatic inlet/isolator with no external work, so stagnation enthalpy is preserved through compression

nominal_full_capture_air_mass_flow.assumption: uniform nominal freestream and full capture of the geometric inlet capture area with no spillage correction

blockers_unchanged: Jin model-B phi=1.04 versus Liu model-B phi=1.03 / model-A phi=1.04 identity conflict
complete Fig. 14 station-3 boundary state is not source-frozen
numerical Cf used by Jin for Fig. 14 is not source-frozen

formal_case_policy.reason: The exact algebraic pt3 constraint is useful, and the nominal energy/mass-flow bridge can bound future work, but exploratory assumptions must not be promoted as measured Fig. 14 inputs.
